answer: The nectar shows someone vouched, the pigment shows someone paid, the ocean shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Parking 182 POA per mask means a farm of 694 masks must set aside 126308 POA before the epoch even opens. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch. Give the epoch a backbone: Horn carver ivory button proof carved within the ivory yard, proved by each ivory button is a measured tusk yield plus an ivory-carver signature, checked by strangers. The farm offered money for the epoch and learned the epoch takes proof, not coins.
